outcomes.studyNotes: When we make a mistake, we say sorry and give a short reason: "I'm sorry I was late. The bus was slow." Do not only say "Sorry." When someone says sorry to you, you accept the apology. Say "That's OK", "No problem" or "Don't worry." Do not say "You're welcome" because that answers thank you, not sorry. In more formal situations you can say "I apologise" and "That's quite all right."
